changes.before: Since then, the economy has made progress toward these goals, and the Committee will continue to assess progress in coming meetings.
changes.after: Since then, the economy has made progress toward these goals. If progress continues broadly as expected, the Committee judges that a moderation in the pace of asset purchases may soon be warranted.

changes.before: Inflation has risen, largely reflecting transitory factors.
changes.after: Inflation is elevated, largely reflecting transitory factors.

changes.before: The sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic have shown improvement but have not fully recovered.
changes.after: The sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic have improved in recent months, but the rise in COVID-19 cases has slowed their recovery.

parsed.rationale: The statement signals that tapering of asset purchases may soon be warranted and describes inflation as elevated, a meaningful hawkish step toward reducing accommodation. This is partly offset by a note that rising COVID cases slowed the recovery, while rate guidance is unchanged.

spans.quote: Since then, the economy has made progress toward these goals, and the Committee will continue to assess progress in coming meetings.
Inflation has risen, largely reflecting transitory factors.
The sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic have shown improvement but have not fully recovered.
Since then, the economy has made progress toward these goals. If progress continues broadly as expected, the Committee judges that a moderation in the pace of asset purchases may soon be warranted.
Inflation is elevated, largely reflecting transitory factors.
The sectors most adversely affected by the pandemic have improved in recent months, but the rise in COVID-19 cases has slowed their recovery.
